sources.title: [2606.25331] Improved Large Language Diffusion Models
sources.snippet: Modern large language models are predominantly trained with autoregressive factorization and causal attention. We present \\emph{iLLaDA}, an 8B masked diffusion language model trained from scratch with fully bidirectional attention. iLLaDA keeps the masked diffusion objective throughout pre-training and supervised fine-tuning (SFT), scaling pre-training to 12T tokens and fine-tuning on a 25B ...

sources.title: Improved Large Language Diffusion Models - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: We present iLLaDA, an 8B fully bidirectional diffusion language model trained from scratch. iLLaDA scales pre-training to 12T tokens and updates several parts of the practical recipe, including the model design, learning-rate schedule, SFT format, confidence-based multiple-choice scoring, and variable-length generation.

sources.title: README.md · GSAI-ML/iLLaDA-8B-Base at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: iLLaDA-8B-Base iLLaDA is an 8B fully bidirectional masked diffusion language model trained from scratch with 12T pre-training tokens, an 8192-token context length, variable-length generation, and confidence-based scoring for multiple-choice evaluation. It was introduced in the paper Improved Large Language Diffusion Models.

sources.title: TL;DR: Improved Large Language Diffusion Models | ArXiv TLDR
sources.snippet: Key contributions Introduces iLLaDA, an 8B masked diffusion language model trained from scratch. Utilizes fully bidirectional attention and a masked diffusion objective throughout pre-training and SFT. Achieves significant performance gains on general, mathematical, and code benchmarks. Remains competitive with autoregressive models like Qwen2.5 7B despite non-autoregressive training.
